einzeiler: NBA Power Poll 1.0 and a deep dive into the Elizabeth Holmes documentary with Wesley…
kurzfassung: The episode opens with a comprehensive early-season NBA Power Poll running through teams from thirty to one. Afterward, film critic Wesley Morris joins the show to discuss the cultural phenomenon and intricate cat-and-mouse dynamics of the new documentary about Elizabeth Holmes directed by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim. They explore the blurred lines between authenticity and performance in modern documentary filmmaking.
stichpunkte: Harsh criticism of the WNBA's scheduling and logistics for the finals
First-week NBA Power Poll ranking all thirty teams in categories
Overreaction takes on early standout performances like Cooper Flagg and Anthony Edwards
Discussion of major injuries hitting teams like Oklahoma City early in the season
Wesley Morris joins to break down the Elizabeth Holmes documentary directed by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim
Analysis of Amanda Seyfried's surprise appearance and incredible acting range in the film
The evolution and financial realities of modern documentary filmmaking versus classic verite style

clips.text: The local sports fans in Milwaukee are completely unfazed by the basketball team's struggles because the local baseball and football teams are performing exceptionally well.

clips.hook: Pathological lying on a grand scale
clips.text: A notoriously deceitful tech founder is examined for her ability to manipulate narratives and generate sympathy despite overwhelming evidence of fraud.

beschreibung:
